card.name: Words before a baseline or current state
card.fires_on: Small linking words (now, in, from, to, and, was) right where the text is about to name a current, existing or baseline state, often a comparison year such as 2005 or 1990, or a prior condition.

modes.label: Comparison year
modes.description: Linking word or space just before a baseline year in emissions or energy comparisons.

modes.label: Currently held role
modes.description: The word now before a participle describing what is held at present.
modes.example: play the role<< now>> held by the United States.

modes.label: Family history check
modes.description: The word and after "assess the family history" in stimulant label warnings.
modes.example: assess the family history<< and>> clinically evaluate patients for tics or Tou

card.writes: It promotes words like existing, current and currently, suggesting the next word describes a present or already established state.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before the text refers to something current or a baseline for comparison.
